name: fundingflow
tagline: Finds government funding programmes for farmers and fills the application forms.
problem: Farmers miss funding they qualify for because programmes are scattered.
solution: Scrapes government programme pages, matches farmers by plain-language description using an open model, and generates plans with auto-filled PDFs.
demo_moment: Team-described: describe the farm and receive a filled application.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won “Real World Prize - Ambrook” among 223 submissions.
Goes from discovery to filled forms.

lessons: Fill the form, not just find it.
